scope: Untimed Vort old production/candidate caller allocator verification; no RSS or wall metric, no competitor encoder
concurrent_environment: Parent family/check on CPUs2-7,10-12; probe compilation CPUs13-15 and encoding CPU8
requested_heap_scope: Requests through public caller page_allocator wrapper, including returned output until explicit caller free; excludes embedded input, codec/tracker stack, code mappings and allocator bookkeeping/page rounding.
limits: One level-3 64KiB XML encode per binary and one tiny first-allocation OOM check; no repeated 14-sample baseline. page_allocator request ledger excludes OS bookkeeping and page rounding, embedded input, stack and executable mappings.
